name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Auto-resizing multi-line text field with the same floating label, helper text and character counter as Text Field.
improvements: Grows with CSS field-sizing: content (no hidden clone div); a scrollHeight + ResizeObserver fallback covers older browsers.
minRows and maxRows limits; past maxRows it scrolls instead of growing forever.
Values set from state or autofill float the label without M.textareaAutoResize().
Character counter, helper and error text are linked with aria-describedby.
